name: 一大兩小圖片拼貼＋右下角文字面板
desc: 左側一個直式大項目、右側兩個橫式項目上下堆疊，拼成整齊的矩形；每個項目的文字面板疊在圖片右下角。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，由三個項目拼貼而成：左右兩欄等寬，左欄放一個大項目，右欄放兩個項目上下堆疊；左側大項目的高度等於右側兩個項目加上間距的總高，整組上下緣對齊成整齊的矩形外框。每個項目是一張卡片，圖片填滿整張卡片，左側大項目用直式圖片，右側兩個用橫式圖片。每張卡片的右下角疊著一塊有自己底色的文字面板，貼齊卡片的下緣與右緣，蓋住圖片右下方的一部分：大項目的面板約佔卡片寬的六成，右側項目的面板約佔七成、高度約佔卡片的四成。面板內左側放標題，上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；同一列右側放按鈕，和標題垂直置中對齊。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，順序是左側大項目、右側上方項目、右側下方項目，每列一個、橫跨內容寬度。每個項目的圖片在上，大項目維持直式、其他維持橫式；文字面板不再疊在圖片上，改放在圖片下方，取消重疊：小標籤與標題在上，按鈕在最下方並橫跨整欄。

en.name: One-large two-small image collage + bottom-right caption panel
en.desc: One large portrait item on the left and two landscape items stacked on the right form a neat rectangle; each item's text panel overlaps the bottom-right corner of its image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content is aligned to the page content width and forms a collage of three items: two equal-width columns, with one large item in the left column and two items stacked vertically in the right column; the large left item is as tall as the two right items plus the gap between them, so the group's top and bottom edges align into a neat rectangular outline. Each item is a card whose image fills the entire card; the large left item uses a portrait image and the two right items use landscape images. In the bottom-right corner of each card sits a text panel with its own background color, flush with the card's bottom and right edges, covering part of the lower-right area of the image: the large item's panel takes about sixty percent of the card width, and the right items' panels take about seventy percent of the width and about forty percent of the card height. Inside the panel, place the title on the left, optionally with a label above it; omit it when there is no content. Place a button on the right of the same row, vertically centered with the title.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout becomes a vertical stack in this order: the large left item, the upper right item, then the lower right item, one per row spanning the content width. Each item shows its image on top, with the large item staying portrait and the others staying landscape; the text panel no longer overlaps the image and moves below it, removing the overlap: the label and title come first, and the button sits at the bottom, spanning the full column.
